entries.german:
Werner Winter von Alzey bekundet, daß er seine Frau Katharina von Rosenberg auf folgende Güter, die er von Graf Johann v. K. zu Lehen trägt, bewittumt hat. Es sind: die Gülte zu Heddesheim (Heidiß-) mit Äckern, Wiesen, Kappaunen, Gültekorn, Weizengülte, Pfenniggülte, Hufengericht und allem, was er dort und in den anderen Dörfern, die dorthin zinsen, besitzt; ferner das Gut zu Bergheim, das den Erben Wiegel Ingrams von Heidelberg für 12 Ml. Korn verliehen ist, und 12 Pfd. Geld vom St. Goarer Zoll. Graf Johann hat dieser Wittumsverschreibung zugestimmt.

Siegler: Siegel des Ausstellers
entries.english:
Werner Winter of Alzey declares that he has settled a widow's estate (Wittum) on his wife Katharina von Rosenberg on the following properties, which he holds as fiefs from Count Johann of K. These are: the revenues at Heddesheim (Heidiß-) with fields, meadows, coppice woods, revenue grain, wheat revenues, penny revenues, hufer court and all that he possesses there and in the other villages that pay tribute there; furthermore the estate at Bergheim, which is held by the heirs of Wiegel Ingram of Heidelberg for 12 measures of grain, and 12 pounds of money from the St. Goar toll. Count Johann has consented to this widow's estate agreement.

Sealer: Seal of the issuer

facts.content: received a Wittum from her husband Werner Winter von Alzey in property at Heddesheim and Bergheim and income from the St. Goar toll.
